## Citrus Blush — G4 unicorn

Citrus Blush is the *fan-given name* of the stylish yellow unicorn who shops at Rarity's Canterlot Carousel in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. You may remember her as the customer whose delight in a one-of-a-kind gown helps Rarity rediscover her creative spark. She's a speaking background mare, often seen near Cayenne and North Point.

Her identifiers are a lemon-yellow coat, flowing two-tone orange mane and tail, pinkish-cerise eyes, and a blue-and-pink compact-mirror cutie mark. The [Canterlot Trendsetters character record](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Canterlot_Trendsetters) documents her design, dialogue, appearances, and attributed English voices: **Shannon Chan-Kent** in season 5 and **Diana Kaarina** in season 6.

**Naming:** Her *show-credit role* is **Fashionable Pony**, not Citrus Blush; Gameloft's officially licensed mobile game uses **Fashionable Unicorn**, in its **Canterlot Trendsetters** collection ([game collection roster](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Collections)). The name *Citrus Blush* circulated as a fan placeholder immediately after her 2015 debut: a [September 12 fan post](https://www.fimfiction.net/blog/536915/i-made-a-group-for-citrus-blush) actively promoted it over the competing fan name *Sally Styles*. There is no verified secret identity.

**Other appearances:** She attends Twilight's lecture in *The Cutie Re-Mark – Part 1* (S5E25), Rarity's show in *Honest Apple* (S7E9), and several Wonderbolts/Washouts events; she appears among King Sombra's mind-controlled Canterlot ponies in *The Beginning of the End – Part 2* (S9E2). These are incidental appearances, not additional speaking roles.

## Important moments

1. **The gown that revives Rarity's creativity — “Canterlot Boutique” (S5E14).** Citrus first says a pretty gown clashes with her complexion, then falls in love with Rarity's imaginative “Fountain of Truth” design; her reaction helps Rarity remember why individual designs matter. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B1G4rPiytnk) · [scene transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Canterlot_Boutique). *Verified scene timestamp unavailable.*
2. **The tyranny of restaurant ratings — “Spice Up Your Life” (S6E12).** When Pinkie Pie and Saffron invite her to the Tasty Treat, Citrus asks how many “hooves” it has, neatly exposing the fashionable herd mentality the episode challenges. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PAAfddIfbRk) · [scene transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Spice_Up_Your_Life). *Verified scene timestamp unavailable; the video's title labels the episode S6E13, although broadcast-order guides list S6E12.*
